stem:
On a winter morning in Jaipur, Meera uses a thermometer to measure the temperature of four cups of milk kept on the kitchen table.
Cup P reads 42 °C, cup Q reads 30 °C, cup R reads 55 °C, and cup S reads 48 °C.
Which cup of milk is the hottest?

options.text: Cup P, because it was measured first
Cup R, because it has the highest temperature reading
Cup Q, because it feels cooler to touch
Cup S, because its reading is closest to 50 °C

teacher.key_rationale: A hotter body has a higher temperature reading on the same scale. Cup R reads 55 °C, which is higher than P (42 °C), Q (30 °C) and S (48 °C), so R is the hottest. Option A is the trap for a student who drops the stated condition (comparing the actual temperature readings) and instead uses measurement order.
